test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Minor arc BC subtends angles BAC and BDC at points A and D, respectively, on the circumference in the major sector of the circle with centre O. What is the value [in degrees] of (∠ABC + ∠ACB), if ∠BDC = 73°?
solution:
**Given:**

 ∠BDC = 73°

**Concept used:**

**Two angles at the circumference standing on the same arc are equal.**

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6544138302d7f2bae281416823ba42fb868020c2c624962aa07900a81049b73d.png] 

Here 

∠BDC = 73° = ∠BAC 

In triangle ABC,

∠ABC + ∠ACB + ∠BAC = 180°

∠ABC + ∠ACB = 180° - 73°

= 107°

**Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.**
